EXTERNAL LOGGER.description: Legacy provider selection used to seed the External Logger grid when migrating a single-destination configuration. Configure current destinations in the grid.

EXTERNAL LOGGER ENABLED.description: Legacy enable flag used when seeding a logger definition. To control forwarding now, set Enabled on the individual logger row and save Preferences.

EXTERNAL LOGGER ADDRESS.description: Legacy address copied when seeding a logger definition. Set the host or URL on the individual destination for the current configuration.

EXTERNAL LOGGER PORT.description: Legacy TCP port copied when seeding a logger definition. Set the port on the individual destination if its provider requires one.

EXTERNAL LOGGER ACCOUNT ID.description: Legacy account identifier used to seed a logger definition. Set the account on the appropriate row in the External Logger grid.

EXTERNAL LOGGER API KEY.description: Legacy API credential used to seed a logger definition. Enter credentials for each destination in the External Logger grid.

EXTERNAL LOGGER LOGBOOK ID.description: Legacy logbook identifier used to seed a logger definition. Choose the logbook on the individual destination.

BACKUP DESTINATION.description: Optional folder for a background copy of the verified local snapshot. An empty setting keeps the local snapshot only. The legacy name BACKUP LOG FILE NAME is still accepted.

BACKUP LOG FREQUENCY.description: Number of newly logged QSOs between automatic backups. Zero disables periodic backups. When enabled, the next QSO also triggers a backup if there is no successful snapshot or it is at least 30 minutes old.

BAND MAP CENTER ON RADIO.description: Center the frequency-ordered band map around the radio. The heading-ordered view disables centering.

BAND MAP FILTER OUT DIGITAL.description: Hide digital spots from the band map. The default is off.

BAND MAP SORT BY BEAM HEADING.description: Order band-map spots by beam heading. Centering on the radio is unavailable while this order is active.

HAMSCORE URL DEFAULT MIGRATED.description: Internal flag recording whether TR4W has checked the saved HamScore URL for the one-time default URL migration. Set the service URL through Online scoring.

SCORE POSTING URL DEFAULT MIGRATED.description: Internal flag recording whether TR4W has checked the saved scoreboard posting URL for the one-time default URL migration. Set the posting URL through Online scoring.

MY PARK.description: Your activating park reference, for example US-0663. It supplies the country prefix for digits-only worked-park entries. ADIF uses the park recorded with each QSO when available, with the current station value as a fallback for older rows.

WSJT-X ENABLED.description: Controls whether TR4W enables the WSJT-X listener. The source initializes this to false: no WSJT-X option is on until the operator turns it on. Match the UDP destination and port in WSJT-X, then verify that a completed contact reaches the intended TR4W contest.

WSJT-X BROADCAST PORT.description: UDP receive port for the WSJT-X connection. Match it to the sending application's port. The initial value is 2237; this is separate from a radio-control TCP port.

WSJT-X MULTICAST GROUP.description: Multicast group for the WSJT-X listener. An empty value selects ordinary unicast. A multicast configuration requires matching group and port settings and an appropriate network interface in the sending application.

WSJT-X SEND HIGHLIGHTS.description: Controls whether TR4W sends callsign highlight information to WSJT-X. The source initializes this to false. Receiving logged QSOs and sending highlights are separate checks; enable Accept UDP requests in WSJT-X when using the highlighting path.

WSJT-X RADIO CONTROL ENABLED.description: Allows frequency changes from WSJT-X to move the radio. The source initializes this to false. Enabling it is not by itself a complete CAT setup; first establish the radio connection and the integration's control path.
